content_html:
LLM · Agent Loop · RAG · Interactive Labs

An open-source interactive engineering guide to LLMs, Agents, and RAG. Every chapter pairs clear mental models with browser labs where you can inspect live payloads, tune parameters, and test failure boundaries.

Zero-Build Labs

Tweak parameters directly in the browser

Payload X-Ray

Inspect real API requests & attention decay

Runnable Reference Code

Every core mechanism maps to runnable examples

Bilingual Edition

Symmetric English & Chinese interactive docs
